name: Crate_Checklist
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (03 Fulfillment / 03 Pick, QC, Rework and Crate, rule CR-R2): the crate weight in kg and its dimensions in cm. Required when Crating Status is set to Done (checked by app/fulfillment/mandatory.py, with the checklist and at least one photo).

fields.name: Crate_Dimensions_Cm
fields.label: Crate dimensions (cm)
fields.helpText: Length x width x height in cm, for example 120 x 60 x 40. Required to mark crating Done (CR-R2).
